newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar emir appoints new cabinet - official decree.
newsitem.headline: Qatar emir appoints new cabinet - official decree.

text.p: Qatar's emir on Wednesday appointed a new cabinet in which the oil, foreign, finance, defence and interior portofolios remained unchanged, an official decree said.

The emir's decree, carried by the official Qatar News Agency, said Prime Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Khalifa al-Thani, who was appointed on Tuesday, retains his post as Interior Minister. Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jabr al-Thani remains Foreign Minister while Sheikh Mohammad bin Khalifa al-Thani remains Finance, Economy and Trade Minister.

The Emir, Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani, remains Defence Minister, while Abdullah bin Hamad al-Attiyah keeps his Energy and Industry portfolio in the oil and gas-rich Gulf Arab state, the decree said.
Several new ministers were appointed in the cabinet which a senior palace official said was sworn in by the emir earlier on Wednesday.
The emir last week named his third son, Sheikh Jassim bin Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani, 18, as Crown Prince.
